tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Page background for every storefront template. Bright white, never cream.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Alternating sections, product image backgrounds, testimonials band, footer.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings, body text, prices and icons on any surface, on accent and on offer.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text (sizes, review meta, helper text) and form-control borders on surface-100 and surface-200.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Primary buttons (Add to cart, Checkout), links, star ratings, active states. Text on it is surface-100 (5.4:1).

tokens.name: leaf
tokens.usage: The logo's leaf green. Illustrations, leaf motifs, large display accents (24px+). Not for small text or button fills.

tokens.name: leaf-tint
tokens.usage: Ingredient tags, selected variant fill, success notices. Text on it is ink.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Lime highlight: CTA banners, 'New' and 'Bestseller' badges, hover underline. Text on it is ink. Never text on white.

tokens.name: offer
tokens.usage: Discount badges and offer banners. Text on it is ink, never white.

tokens.name: offer-strong
tokens.usage: Sale price text on surface-100 and surface-200 (5.2:1).

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Card outlines and dividers only. Not for form-control borders (use ink-muted).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Form errors, out-of-stock notices. Always paired with text.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between icon and label, badge padding, between price and compare-at price.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Tight stacks and rows: gap between chips, between hero buttons on mobile, between a tile image and its label, newsletter field and button.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on mobile, button horizontal padding, mobile page gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop, gap between product cards, form field spacing.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section head to content on desktop, CTA banner padding on mobile, hero column gap on mobile.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Vertical spacing between homepage sections on mobile (double it on desktop), desktop page gutter.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, quantity selector, small badges.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Product cards, image frames, banners, drawers and modals.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, variant chips, ingredient tags.
